summary: Verified TeacherSubjectAtt.jsx auto-save refactor (Simpan button removed; every status click auto-POSTs 1 student). Tested at 1920x1080 desktop and 390x844 mobile. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) AUTO-SAVE persists after reload (200 OK, verified via reload), (2) 'Simpan' text/button not visible in toolbar — only Mulai Panggil + Selesai & Kunci/Buka Kunci remain, (3) Call mode auto-saves per student + advances progress + close via X preserves data on reload, (4) Lock flow: lock badge appears, first click while locked triggers window.confirm exactly once (accepted), subsequent clicks in same locked session skip confirm, unlock also confirms and clears badge, (5) Mobile viewport shows no horizontal overflow, 2-button toolbar wraps cleanly, no console errors, mobile cards sa-m-<status>-<id> auto-save works. Emergency unlock cleanup executed once (session was left locked from previous playwright timeout). Final state clean: session unlocked, all touched students restored to initial statuses (Adi=alpha, Bang Virus=alpha, Danil=izin, rest hadir).
critical_code_review_comments: autoSave (line 47-61) correctly does optimistic UI update then rollback on error via prev value + toast — good UX.

confirmedRef ref (line 45) is reset by remount pattern: it lives inside component; when date/subject/cls change, students refetch but the component is not remounted, so confirmedRef is NOT reset automatically. Only reason it works is that a fresh session load will typically not be locked. Suggest resetting confirmedRef.current=false inside the useEffect at line 33 when date/subject/cls change (spec explicitly says 'confirmedRef direset saat ganti tanggal/mapel/kelas'). Currently this is a minor gap — behavior may leak across selection changes.
sa-save button kept as hidden button (line 110-112) is dead code; safe to remove to reduce DOM noise.
Imports Save & CheckCheck already removed (line 5 imports only BookOpen, Lock, LockOpen, Megaphone, X) — matches spec.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not retested — backend unchanged per spec)

context_for_next_testing_agent: TeacherSubjectAtt.jsx auto-save flow verified end-to-end. If main agent addresses the confirmedRef reset gap in the useEffect at line 33 (setting confirmedRef.current=false when date/subject/cls change), a quick regression can be done by changing date, verifying confirm dialog re-appears on first status click while locked. Session state at end of run: UNLOCKED, all students at initial statuses. Data-testid conventions: sa-<status>-<id> (desktop table), sa-m-<status>-<id> (mobile card), sa-call-<status> (call modal), sa-call-start, sa-lock, sa-locked-badge, sa-call-modal, sa-call-close.
